guardEvidence.howCaught: The change adds no new self-triggered controller. The only repeated self-emission it introduces — loader-diagnostic reporting on quiet per-admission reloads — settles by construction: fingerprint (level|line) transition dedup reports each diagnostic once on appearance, is silent while it stands, and reports once again only on clear-then-recur; steady-state emission per standing diagnostic is O(1), proven by the appear/clear/recur test. Spawn topic binding and relay destination confirmation are subtractive authorities (they refuse spawns / refuse false 'sent'), and retries remain owned by the existing bounded DeliveryRetryManager.
